decisions.reason: Adding dashboard and email winner notifications does not change the Big Block prize amounts, trigger, eligibility, funding, or reset mechanics.
Winner-notification channels do not change the Small Block prize parameters or ticket lifecycle; its same-message timing update concerns a separate clause.
Notification of selected winners does not alter the VRF provider, selection method, eligible population, weighting, fairness, or verification method.
Winner notification is owned by the source Requirement and does not further change the candidate's automatic direct-wallet prize delivery state.
Winner notifications do not affect publication of prize-pool values through unauthenticated public APIs.
Notification channels do not alter allocation of tickets from mints that omit a referral code.
Notification of prize winners does not change referral-triggered ticket issuance, recipients, quantities, cycles, or secondary-sale behavior.
The existing message-184 FAQ MODIFY already records dashboard and email winner notifications in the reward and fiat-buyer copy, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Adding notification channels does not change the separate Small Block and Big Block ticket counters or their reset behavior.
Winner notifications have no effect on the Aave yield provider, prize-pool yield behavior, or unresolved Aave lifecycle question.
Prize-winner notification channels do not change the referral-code basis, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The existing message-184 About-page MODIFY already incorporates dashboard and email winner notifications in the rewards process copy, so no further Event change is required.
